title: GT3582 V-Band Turbocharger (Billet Wheel, Anti-Surge Housing, T3 0.63 A/R)
description: Built for fast spool and mid-range punch, this GT3582 is ideal for street and track setups targeting 400 to 600 horsepower. It features a lightweight CNC billet compressor wheel (61.5mm inducer / 81.5mm exducer) inside a slotted anti-surge housing, flowing up to 60–65 lb/min of air to prevent compressor flutter under load. The compact 0.63 A/R exhaust housing paired with a T3 inlet allows typical 2.0L to 3.0L engines to reach full boost early—around 3,200 to 3,500 RPM—while holding strong up to 22 PSI. It features a standard 3-inch V-band exhaust outlet for straightforward downpipe fabrication, alongside dual oil and water cooling ports to protect the bearings under heavy driving.
